title: Template:Clan-info
wikitext:
Template intended for use in [[:Category:Clans|clan]] articles. All fields are optional and are hidden if empty. == Usage == === Example === 
{{Clan-info
 | foundedyear = 1936
 | foundedmonth = January
 | foundedday = 15
 | foundedby = [[Image:flag_fr.gif]] [[Georges Bataille]]
 | disbanded = 1939
 | nationality = French
 | shortnationality = fr
 | prefix = acp
 | color1 = 1
 | color2 = 4
 | ircchannel = acéphale
 | ircnetwork = irc.enterthegame.com
 | ircnetworkname = EnterTheGame
 | website = http://i.a.m.free.fr/acephale/
}}
The code above will appear as follows. {{Clan-info | foundedyear = 1936 | foundedmonth = January | foundedday = 15 | foundedby = [[Image:flag_fr.gif]] [[Georges Bataille]] | disbanded = 1939 | nationality = French | shortnationality = fr | prefix = acp | color1 = 1 | color2 = 4 | ircchannel = acéphale | ircnetwork = irc.enterthegame.com | ircnetworkname = EnterTheGame | website = http://i.a.m.free.fr/acephale/ }}
    {{ #if: {{{foundedyear|}}} |
  • '''Founded:''' {{ #if: {{{foundedmonth|}}} | {{{foundedmonth|}}} {{ #if: {{{foundedday|}}} | {{{foundedday|}}}|}}, |}} [[{{{foundedyear|}}}]] {{ #if: {{{foundedby|}}} | by {{{foundedby|}}} |}} [[Category:Clans started in {{{foundedyear|}}}]] |}} {{ #if: {{{disbanded|}}} |
  • '''Disbanded:''' [[{{{disbanded|}}}]] |}} {{ #if: {{{nationality|}}} |
  • '''Nationality:''' [[Image:flag_{{{shortnationality|}}}.gif]] [[{{{nationality|}}}]] |}} {{ #if: {{{prefix|}}} |
  • '''Clan prefix:''' {{{prefix|}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{color1|}}} |
  • '''Clan colors:''' {{Qwcolor{{{color1|}}}}} {{Qwcolor{{{color2|}}}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{ircchannel|}}} |
  • '''IRC channel:''' [irc://{{{ircnetwork|}}}/{{{ircchannel|}}} #{{{ircchannel|}}}] {{ #if: {{{ircnetworkname|}}} | ([[{{{ircnetworkname|}}}]]) |}} |}} {{ #if: {{{website|}}} |
  • '''Website:''' [{{{website|}}} {{{website|}}}] |}}
